title: Feature cards: three paper cards, each a colour field with one picture, a bold title, one sentence and an arrow link, under a serif heading
use: Three things a product does; field_start and subject_start rotate the fields and pictures.

field_start.note: field of the first card (sage, blush, lilac, sky, sand; the rest follow)

subject_start.note: which picture: 0 hand-graph, 1 seedling, 2 book, 3 magnifier, 4 spark-hands, 5 path, 6 candles, 7 compass

lede.default: 每一步都留下证据，换一个人也能重跑。

text_1.default: 把假设、数据口径和因子写在同一处，改动有记录。

text_2.default: 同一份配置能重跑，结果带着参数和随机种子。

text_3.default: 持仓、延迟和风控状态在一个面板里。

relations: Three cards 464 x 650 with a 24 gap and 80 inset, paper #F5F4ED, radius 16, padding 32; each has a 400-unit square field with its picture at 80%, a bold 24 title 56 units under it, a 16 sans body in two lines and a 16 medium link at the foot.
Fields cycle sage, blush, lilac, sky, sand from field_start; pictures run from subject_start; a flat accent never matches its field.
decoration: The cards, the fields and the pictures with their line filter; the text slots are the only measured content.

provenance.corpus: product-site kit (examples/brand-band-site-kit): our own original one-page site in Chinese in the brand-band grammar; all copy is a placeholder
provenance.experiment: styles/brand-band/style.json provenance (public pages measured privately in Chrome on 2026-11-21; never shipped); the pictures are our own code-drawn illustrations
provenance.method: The measured card row (571 x 426, radius 16, padding 32, gap 24) with the oat band's colour-field tile pulled into each card; titles bold 22 scaled to 24.
measured: Cards #F5F4ED, radius 16, padding 32, title bold 22 / 27.5, body 15 / 22.5 #3D3D3A, tile #BCD1CA.
Template: every subject and field offset passes the static check.
